mapper.sql: t.id, t.tenant_id, t.customer_id, t.assignee_user_id, t.original_assignee_user_id, t.task_team_id, t.task_type, t.priority, t.status, t.title, t.description, t.due_at, t.source_type, t.source_ref, t.claimed_at, t.completed_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.version
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pendingTaskCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.task_type = 'FOLLOWUP' AND t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < #{dayEndExclusive} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dueFollowupCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < #{now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdueTaskCount FROM crm_task t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING')
SELECT FROM crm_task t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_task (tenant_id, customer_id, assignee_user_id, original_assignee_user_id, task_team_id, task_type, priority, status, title, description, due_at, source_type, source_ref) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{customerId}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{originalAssigneeUserId}, #{taskTeamId}, #{taskType}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{title}, #{description}, #{dueAt}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_task SET task_type = #{taskType}, priority = #{priority}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, due_at = #{dueAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_task_action_log (tenant_id, task_id, action, from_status, to_status, from_assignee_user_id, to_assignee_user_id, actor_user_id, reason, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{taskId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{fromAssigneeUserId}, #{toAssigneeUserId}, #{actorUserId}, #{reason}, #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, task_id, action, from_status, to_status, from_assignee_user_id, to_assignee_user_id, actor_user_id, reason, idempotency_key, created_at FROM crm_task_action_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_task SET customer_id = #{toCustomerId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{fromCustomerId}
